newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL, TVK steady after 4-yr deal.
newsitem.headline: MOL, TVK steady after 4-yr deal.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian oil company MOL and chemicals maker TVK were virtually unchanged on Friday, after they had signed a four year delivery deal.
MOL stocks opened at 3,105 forints, a fraction below Thursday's close of 3,110 and at 1053 GMT they traded at 3,105.
TVK shares opened at 2,250 forints, unchanged from Thursday's last price and after advancing to 2,265 in the first minutes of trade they had retreated. At 1056 GMT TVK traded at 2,250.
"The only thing we can say about these two stocks is that at least they are not falling," one trader said.

Under the deal MOL will deliver about one million tonnes of chemical benzene and gas oil to TVK per year, and will buy back the motor fuel components and benzol product made of these materials for further processing.

Traders said earlier today they did not expect the news to have substantial impact on MOL's price as investors were waiting for news about the share's pricing in an offering planned for the next few months, but expected some rise by TVK.
